description:
**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a **Basketball Pricing Analyst (Sports Trader)** to join our **Trading Team**, helping to shape the odds and betting markets that customers engage with. We're looking for someone with a passion for NBA and also ideally WNBA.

Whether you have a numbers background, have studied analytics, worked in sports, or are just obsessed with Basketball, we'd love to support your growth into a trading role. No prior trading or gambling experience is required.

This is a hybrid position with office presence required in Jersey City, NJ (just across the river from Manhattan). In this role, expect to be predominantly in-office for hands-on training and core Trading tasks. The office contains an open space with a hot-desk environment. Each station has multiple monitors and there are TVs and constant noise in the office. You'll also work regular late shifts (typically 2:30pm–10:30pm ET), which will include assisting the team with live betting. This role requires weekend work.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined below, employees may occasionally be asked to support other duties in line with evolving business needs and their preferences.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**
  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

As a Sports Trader, you'll start by learning the core skills that power our odds and markets. You'll receive hands-on training in how sports betting works, how we use models and data to manage prices, and how we monitor news and customer behavior to keep our pricing sharp.

Your day-to-day will include:

* Learning to set and manage prices on basketball games, player stats, and futures markets — from pre-game to live in-play odds — using our in-house tools and models.
* Monitoring real-time news, stats, and industry pricing to help guide trading decisions.
* Trading live games in real time; making quick adjustments to pricing based on game flow, key events, and customer behavior.
* Collaborating with other Traders and working cross-functionally with other teams within the Risk & Trading department or across the wider FanDuel business, in a cooperative and inclusive environment.
* Helping brainstorm new products or ways to improve the customer experience, with consideration for how fans engage with the game.

You'll work alongside experienced Traders who will guide your development. Over time, you'll gain the confidence and expertise to price markets independently, manage risk, and shape the sports betting experience for our customers.

  

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* A deep passion for NBA or WNBA (more than one league is a plus)
* A bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience. Recent or soon-to-be graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong comfort with numbers, odds and probability, and quick mental math skills
* It's important to understand how odds relate to probability (%), and how betting markets work in that sense. You do not have to bet yourself.
* Proficiency with Excel. Experience with AI tooling
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, plus the curiosity to research and stay ahead of news and trends.
* Comfortable making decisions under pressure, while staying responsive to rapidly changing information
* Ability to work outside typical business hours, including nights and weekends. Traders work roughly 50-70 weekend shifts per year (only ever 5 days per week)
* Must be eligible to work in the U.S and to obtain a DGE license for trading activities.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

We started Chaffin Luhana in January 2010 because we wanted to build a firm where our actions match our values. Since then, our attorneys have recovered more than $1 billion for injured people, and state and federal judges have appointed us to lead national product liability litigation. Our ethos is Doing Good by Doing Right™.  
We are looking for a full-time COO to join us as the senior-most business leader in the firm. We run on EOS, and you will serve as our Integrator, reporting directly to the two founding partners.  
Here is the honest context. We built this firm’s operations ourselves, and the firm has outgrown the way we built them. We have strong department leaders, a growing brand, and some very good years in front of us. What we don't have is one person who is fully engaged in driving the business forward: someone who identifies the priorities, brings us recommendations, and gets the team executing without either founder having to keep pushing things along (or getting in the way). Everything else in this description is detail. That is the job.  
  
**Why Be the COO at Chaffin Luhana?**  
**Run the business.** You will run the whole business, not a slice of it. Marketing, intake, client experience, finance, people, and technology all report through this seat, and you will work directly with the two founders on where the firm goes next.  
**Help shape what comes next.** AI, management services organizations (MSOs), and changing client expectations are creating new choices for law firms. Help us evaluate those choices and remain competitive while staying true to our ethos. We want your judgment about where to invest, what to change, and what to protect.  
**The timing is genuinely good.** We have significant litigation maturing over the next few years and the resources to invest ahead of it. This is a role for a growing firm that needs a real operator at the wheel.  
**You will build, not maintain.** Our reporting and analytics are partially built, and finishing that work is yours to own and design. A year from now, the way this firm makes decisions should reflect how you decided it should work.  
**The mission is real.** We describe ourselves as data driven but heart led. Our clients come to us during the darkest time in their lives, and we believe one of our strongest differentiators is the compassion we have across the team. We hire by our values, promote by them, and have parted ways with talented people over them.  
**We have staying power.** Mass torts and contingency work run on long business cycles, and plenty of firms don't last. We've been doing this for fifteen years, we've grown through the hard parts, and it's been worth the push.  
**Help people become their best.** We want our team members to grow professionally and personally, become exceptional colleagues and leaders, and give clients an incredible experience. Strong operations should help our attorneys and team deliver outstanding litigation and trial results. Compassion, high standards, and accountability belong together here.

**The authority to lead**
=========================

Once you understand the business and have established an operating plan with the founders, you will have authority to allocate the approved budget, make hiring and firing decisions, change leadership when needed, and direct marketing execution. We expect you to use that authority and develop leaders who own their responsibilities.  
You will work with the founders on firm strategy and major investments, keeping us informed about performance and significant decisions. We welcome thoughtful challenge, clear recommendations, and sound judgment. Attorneys retain responsibility for legal judgment and litigation strategy.  
  
**What you will own**

**Priorities and execution**
============================

Translate the partners’ vision into the annual plan and quarterly Rocks. Bring your recommendation on what matters most, identify capacity constraints, and keep the firm focused—including telling the founders when we are adding too much.  
Run leadership meetings that end in decisions, owners, and deadlines. Make sure the work gets done between meetings and that department leaders take responsibility for results.

**Business reporting and analytics**
====================================

Complete the reporting buildout with Finance and Technology: consistent KPI definitions, reliable data, named owners, and dashboards leaders actually use. Determine the expertise needed, whether an analyst hire or outside support, and drive the work to completion. This is a core first-year deliverable.  
Understand the numbers well enough to challenge assumptions, explain what is changing, and recommend action. Connect marketing, intake, case inventory, staffing, and financial information.

**Marketing and intake**
========================

Own case acquisition economics end to end: spend, lead quality, conversion, cost per qualified signed case, and expected case value by market, practice area, and channel. Hold Marketing and Intake leaders accountable for both case quality and signed-case targets.  
Pressure-test changes in spending and strategy. Watch leading indicators and act before a shortfall becomes a revenue problem, accounting for different PI and mass tort timelines. Assess whether the right people are in the right seats and make changes when needed.

**Leadership and people**

Lead department heads, address missed commitments directly, and develop managers who solve problems at their own level. Partner with People Services on hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management.

First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

Envelope is a property analytics and zoning technology platform that uses zoning regulations and property data to visualize and evaluate the development potential of a site. The platform helps translate complex zoning requirements into actionable property and development insights. The Senior Zoning Analyst is responsible for performing advanced zoning research and analysis, with a primary focus on interpreting New York City zoning regulations and evaluating their application to real property within the proprietary Envelope platform.  
  
Serves as a subject matter resource on complex zoning matters and regulatory changes. Translates zoning requirements into structured logic and product requirements, validates technology-generated zoning analyses through manual testing, and prepares client-ready zoning analyses.  
  
Partners with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to support the accuracy and continued development of Envelope and related zoning products.  
  
Works with sales reps to present and market the product when a more advanced subject matter expert is needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Research and interpret NYC zoning regulations, maps, amendments, resolutions, and other applicable land-use requirements.
* Analyze development standards, including permitted uses, FAR, bulk, height and setback, yards, lot coverage, density, parking, special districts, overlays, and applicable bonuses.
* Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on properties, zoning analyses, product logic, data, and internal processes.
* Serve as a subject matter resource on complex or ambiguous zoning provisions.
* Perform zoning feasibility and baseline site analyses to test and validate Envelope outputs against applicable regulations, property data, and manual calculations.
* Provide guidance and technical support to less experienced zoning analysts on complex zoning research and interpretation.
* Translate complex zoning provisions into clear rules, calculations, and step-by-step logic for use within Envelope and related products.
* Partner with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to translate zoning requirements into business, data, and product requirements.
* Communicate complex zoning requirements and findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Participate as needed in client meetings, product demonstrations, training, and presentations.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Familiarity with New York City zoning regulations, including the NYC Zoning Resolution and zoning maps.
* Strong understanding of zoning concepts such as FAR, permitted uses, bulk and dimensional requirements, height and setback regulations, density, special districts, overlays, and other development controls.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex, text-based regulations into clear, structured rules, calculations, and logical requirements.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate zoning code changes and determine their practical impact on properties, analyses, processes, data, and products.
* Strong quality-control and technical-review skills, including the ability to manually validate technology-generated zoning analyses.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex zoning concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams, including technology, product, engineering, operations, GIS/data, and client-facing teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Familiarity with NYC property and planning data sources and mapping tools, such as PLUTO/MapPLUTO and ZoLa, preferred.
* Experience with GIS or mapping software, such as ArcGIS or QGIS, preferred.
* Familiarity with architectural or development analysis tools, such as AutoCAD or Rhino, is a plus.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in urban planning, real estate, architecture, land use, geography, or a related field required.
* 5+ years of directly related zoning, land-use, planning, real estate, or regulatory analysis experience.
* Demonstrated experience independently researching and interpreting zoning regulations required.
* Experience reviewing zoning code amendments and regulatory changes and determining their impact strongly preferred.
* Experience with New York City zoning regulations, the NYC Zoning Resolution, and land-use requirements strongly preferred.
* Experience performing zoning feasibility, development potential, or site analysis preferred.
* Experience working with zoning, GIS, property-data, or real estate technology platforms preferred.

**A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE**

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

  

**What you will do**

The PGIM Strategy team supports the CEO of PGIM and the whole leadership team in developing and executing strategy around the business’ most critical priorities. The Strategy team works on a wide variety of projects including competitor analysis, market evaluation and entry, and mergers and acquisitions. The Strategy Senior Analyst/Associate role is the ideal opportunity for an ambitious and talented candidate to work in a collegial and high performing team, and build experience working in the asset management industry directly supporting senior business leaders.

As an Senior Analyst, you will be part of a small strategy team overseen by the Chief Strategy Officer. You will be given high levels of responsibility across multiple projects, and asked to tackle complex business challenges from day one.

You may be asked to evaluate the size and growth potential of a market like the alternatives universe and develop potential strategies for entering the market. You may also be asked to analyze how our top competitors are responding to market dynamics, or to help evaluate and diligence potential acquisition targets. These projects will provide you with exposure to PGIM and the asset management industry, and you will develop a broad business strategy toolkit. In addition to conducting research and analysis, you will be responsible for presenting your findings and recommendations to senior management. You will also have the opportunity to be mentored by PGIM’s senior business leaders and be coached and trained by asset management and strategy experts.

This position is based in our office in Newark, NJ and will follow a hybrid schedule. Our organization follows a hybrid work structure ( 3 days in office) where employees can work remotely and/ from the office, as needed, based on demands of specific tasks or personal work preferences. Working from the office is encouraged when working on tasks that require a high degree of collaboration.

**What you can expect**

* Develop problem statements and structure problem solving approaches to PGIM’s most critical challenges
* Establish the fact-base to aid in answering the PGIM senior management’s most pressing questions
* Conduct strategic analyses of markets, competitors, products, and client segments to identify growth opportunities across PGIM's global investment businesses.
* Prepare presentations and recommendations for senior executives, management committees, and board-level discussions.
* Lead competitor intelligence, industry benchmarking, and thematic research initiatives covering traditional and alternative asset management.
* Support corporate development, partnership evaluation, and business planning efforts through commercial due diligence and financial analysis.
* Coordinate cross-functional strategic initiatives, working closely with investment, distribution, finance, and corporate leadership teams to drive execution of key priorities

**What you will bring**

* BA Required with strong academic background
* 2-4 years of experience, preferably in internal strategy, management consulting, or banking
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills
* Passion for problem solving
* Demonstrated leadership and teamwork abilities
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Executive presence and the composure to interact with senior leaders
* Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to work independently
* Interest in business strategy/development and asset management

**What will set you Apart**

* Knowledge of financial services, ideally asset management and/or private markets (e.g., private equity, private credit, real estate, etc.,)

* **PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

The salary range for this role is from $110,000 to $125,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills.

======================

* **Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level.**
* **Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave.**
* 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%).

* **Work/Life Resources** to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development.

**DISTINGUISHING FEATURES OF WORK:** Court Analysts work under direct supervision, individually or on project teams, performing
  
confidential analysis, research, planning, and other related duties in one or more of the following areas: budget development and
  
court finance; personnel administration; resource allocation; and court system management and administration.

**ASSIGNMENT:** Join a dynamic, fast-paced, and innovative team dedicated to strengthening New York State’s justice system by
  
enhancing courtroom functionality and improving courthouse accessibility statewide.
  
  
The Analyst will support high-volume audiovisual modernization initiatives and will carry several key logistical responsibilities within
  
the NYC DCM Office. These include managing inventory for incoming equipment orders, processing work orders for equipment
  
distributed to NYC court locations as part of modernization initiatives using our asset and maintenance management platform,
  
coordinating equipment shipments or preparing items for local delivery by DCM staff, and organizing, maintaining, and auditing of
  
storage locations in the NYC DCM Office. The Analyst will develop a basic understanding of DCM technology to empower them to
  
suggest alternate parts if requested equipment is out of stock
  
  
Additional responsibilities include assisting DCM’s training team during courtroom technology training in the NYC area as necessary,
  
assisting with coordinating video conferencing between the courts and state or federal facilities, as well as conducting database
  
evaluation, reporting, and compliance activities to ensure that all statewide courtrooms and public spaces are accurately
  
documented using DCM’s customized court inventory database. This documentation includes technology assets, acoustic
  
treatments, and other accessibility or quality-of-life improvements.
  
  
In this role, the Analyst will directly contribute to a more efficient, accessible, and equitable justice system. By supporting the
  
technology used daily by judicial and non-judicial staff and enhancing the experience of the many New Yorkers who interact with
  
our courts, the Analyst will play a meaningful part in delivering high-quality public service to communities across the NYC Metro
  
area.
